Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug** in this channel. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan.

In the meantime, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard, as you noted in that same 10:42 message. Mateo reported six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when Mateo said the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You posted at 11:08 that both lanes were working as of 11:07.

The ticket SUP-5380 log also has an entry at 08:12 that morning saying the reboot had failed and drivers were queuing. That is earlier than your first report in the channel, so check whether it belongs in the postmortem timeline.
